channel.title: morningNewsSection1
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The hidden economics in the new Planet Money board game
item.description: From Nobel-winning research to the Laffer Curve and inside jokes, the game embeds economic concepts and humor throughout.

item.title: Syrian court sentences former President Assad to death in absentia
item.description: A Syrian court handed down a death sentence to Assad and his brother for crimes against humanity and war crimes during the 14-year conflict.

item.title: One year on, National Guard integrated into D.C. life; deadly quake hits Colombia
item.description: It has been a year since the National Guard was deployed to Washington, D.C. This update covers developments since then, plus a 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia.

item.title: Midwife bridges 'maternity deserts' to support Black mothers and infants
item.description: March of Dimes research shows over half of U.S. counties lack labor and delivery hospitals. A Black midwife works to fill the gap.
